en.askTitle: Put in your own city, job offer and family and get the same permit-route comparison and first-year budget
en.runTitle: A French family from Lyon moving to Montréal: a CAD 115,000 job offer starting September 2027

fields.label: Employer, role, salary and start date
fields.value: a software company in Montréal, CAD 115,000 a year, starting September 2027

fields.label: Adults’ ages and occupations, children’s ages
fields.value: Claire (38, hospital pharmacist) and Julien (40, software project manager); children aged 7 and 11

en.template: Help me plan a move from {city} to Montréal. The job offer is {offer}; the family is {family}. Check which LMIA stream and NOC/TEER code the employer is likely to use, whether my spouse can get an open work permit, which RAMQ and school steps apply, and what the recognition path for {profession} looks like. Rebuild the first-year budget with my own rent, savings and employer-benefit figures, and flag anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the official pages on work permits, schools, health cover, pharmacist recognition, rents and tax
phases.note: Quebec and federal immigration pages, RAMQ, the pharmacists’ order, rental board and exchange rate
phases.judgment: It did not repeat the usual “three-month wait” for health cover. The official page exempts people arriving from a country with a social-security agreement, which includes France, and it flagged that Claire’s cover depends on her permit type: an open work permit may not qualify, and that stayed marked unresolved.

phases.title: Write the guide, route comparison and first-year budget with the arithmetic shown
phases.note: Recommended permit route, timeline, rent examples, tax estimate and euro conversion
phases.judgment: The budget ends about CAD 3,464 short: net pay of about CAD 79,671 against outlays of about CAD 83,135. The guide states plainly that rent, groceries, utilities, phones and setup are its own placeholders, not sourced figures.

phases.title: Independent check of every money figure and claim against the sources
phases.judgment: A separate colleague recomputed every money figure on their own, and all matched to the cent. They also flagged six wording and citation problems, including a filing-time statement that clashed with the six-month rule. All were fixed, and the summary says openly that the check was not re-run after those edits.

workers: Read the official rules on French- versus English-language schooling and enrolment, and on public health-insurance cover in Quebec
Checked how a French pharmacy degree is recognised by Quebec’s pharmacists’ order: steps, fees, the exam route and the internship
Collected dated 3-bedroom rent examples in Rosemont, Villeray and Outremont, plus tenancy rules, transit fares and the euro–dollar rate
Read the official Canada and Quebec pages on the work-permit route: job-market approval, Quebec acceptance certificate, fees, processing times and permits for the spouse and children
Gathered the federal and Quebec income-tax, pension, employment-insurance and parental-insurance figures needed to estimate take-home pay
Independent check: recomputed every money figure separately and traced the guide’s claims back to the sources list
